materialization_plan.download_script:
python - <<'PY'
import json
import urllib.request
from pathlib import Path
artifact = json.loads(Path('artifacts/v3_predicted_structure_fold_channel_current702_20260601.json').read_text())
seen = set()
for group in artifact['foldseek_input_manifest']['coordinate_request_groups'].values():
    for item in group:
        path = item.get('expected_local_path')
        url = item.get('url')
        if not path or not url or path in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(path)
        target = Path(path)
        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        if not target.exists():
            urllib.request.urlretrieve(url, target)
PY
